text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Gold City's debut race, and she's approached by reporters eager to know her future plans. Some are hoping she'll run in the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Gold City wants them to concentrate on her running, they appear fixated on her looks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated to only be appreciated for her physical appearance, she seems desperate to prove through her race results that there's more to her than looks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her to run like herself, but she dismisses my advice as "a given" as she walks off to the starting gate.
